dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies entering into covered settlement agreements and parties involved in those settlements.
dimensions.evidence: the head of each agency that has entered into a covered settlement agreement shall establish and maintain a public online database

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative recordkeeping and online publication requirements on federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: establish and maintain a public online database that... contains the following information and documents

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for agencies to build and maintain online databases, but no specific monetary appropriations are stated.
Amends title 5 of the United States Code to mandate new cross-agency reporting, data standards, and transparency rules.
dimensions.evidence: To amend chapter 3 of title 5, United States Code, to require the publication of settlement agreements

dimensions.assessment: Requires permanent ongoing database maintenance and annual reporting, applying retroactively back to 2015 where practicable.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than annually... apply with respect to any covered settlement agreement... entered into on or after January 1, 2015

importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies to establish public online databases of covered settlement agreements meeting specific thresholds, increasing transparency and administrative reporting.
